title: Inklet
move_pattern: Starts with Jab (or Whirlwind if MiddleInklet variant). After Jab, randomly chooses between Piercing Gaze or Whirlwind with equal probability. Both Piercing Gaze and Whirlwind return to Jab.
notes: Piercing Gaze is a hidden move and is not displayed in the bestiary. The MiddleInklet property determines whether the monster starts with Whirlwind instead of Jab.
